card.text: Explore Romulus, a moon of Sylvia, through its explicitly approximate occultation shape.

introduction.text: Romulus is Sylvia’s outer moon. This approximation selects one published occultation-limb solution and assumes equal depth. A later reanalysis admits different correlated limb shapes, so this is not a unique measured figure. The grid marks unmapped terrain. The orbit follows a published model; its current phase is approximate.

model.title: Occultation shape approximation
model.summary: One published projected-limb solution, 23.1±0.7 km area-equivalent diameter and 2.7±0.3 axis ratio, with equal depth assumed. The 2020 reanalysis allows other correlated ellipse shapes. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
